entity.summary: Self-custody multichain cryptocurrency wallet from EMM Ventures AG with native cross-chain swaps, DeFi features, multisig support and integrated card spending capabilities.
entity.notes: THORWallet's current first-party site states 'Since 2021' and repeatedly describes the wallet as self-custody/non-custodial.

products.summary: THORWallet self-custody multichain mobile wallet for swaps, DeFi, multisig and integrated spending features.
products.notes: The first-party homepage currently distributes THORWallet through the App Store and Google Play.

events.title: THORWallet Card launched
events.description: THORWallet announced that its card was live, adding Mastercard spending to the self-custody wallet experience. Current first-party material advertises Basic and Premium card tiers and describes the card offering as distinct from the existing Swiss IBAN card program.
events.notes: WLR records this as a wallet capability/lifecycle event. The payment-card program itself belongs in Crypto Card Lifecycle Registry. Country-count claims vary across current first-party surfaces, so this event does not canonicalize one exact global country count.

evidence.title: THORWallet — Self-Custody Multi-Chain Crypto Wallet, Swaps & DeFi
evidence.notes: First-party homepage describes THORWallet as self-custody/non-custodial, says 'Since 2021', and links iOS and Android distribution.

evidence.title: Swap Anything, Spend Anywhere: The THORWallet Card Is Live
evidence.notes: The current first-party homepage lists the dated 2026-08-31 card-live announcement and presents the live card tiers.

evidence.title: THORWallet Card Waitlist - Join Early Access
evidence.notes: First-party card page describes Basic/Premium as an offering additional to the existing Swiss IBAN card program and advertises broad international availability.
